witness.branch: Leaving a curb into a vehicle path.
witness.quote: A pedestrian shall not suddenly leave a curb or other place of safety
witness.reason: The pedestrian ego can travel from the fixed curb into a separately constructed vehicle path.
required_context: Construct close approaches and retain conflict geometry and physical opportunities to yield without declaring impossibility.
Construct close vehicle approaches for physical analysis without declaring suddenness or impossibility.
Declare assumptions for any physical stopping model without equating yielding exclusively with stopping.
Establish curb location, adjacent travel areas and pedestrian route.
Establish the curb, adjacent travel areas, pedestrian route and separate qualifying vehicle and driver.
Identify the ego as a qualifying pedestrian and add a separate qualifying vehicle and driver.
Preserve all introductory exception references and distinguish the supplied NRS 484B.287(1)(c) from the remaining unavailable provisions.
Retain motion before curb departure and through entry into the vehicle's path.
Retain pedestrian and vehicle motion before departure, through departure and through actual path entry; roadway entry alone is insufficient.
witness.subject_reason: The available pedestrian is the prohibited-action subject; the vehicle driver is a separate participant.
